scope_selection.note: Absent from v1 and a common cause of silent mis-loads on HKEX filings.

entity_scope.rule: Where a statement prints Group and Company columns side by side, take the Group (consolidated) column. Record entity_scope on every fact. Never mix columns within one statement.
company_only_markers: Presence of bs_non_current_assets__investments_in_subsidiaries on the face is strong evidence the column is company-only, since consolidation eliminates it.

period_selection.rule: Identify the current period from the column heading date, not from column position; HKEX filings are not consistently current-first. Load comparatives only into the comparative period slot.
period_selection.restatement_rule: Where a comparative column is labelled restated / 重列 / 經重列, load it as the comparative and set restated: true. Do not overwrite a previously loaded original comparative; keep both with a restatement flag.

units_and_currency.rule: Resolve currency and scale from the statement header, not the cover page, and re-resolve per statement. Persist unit on every fact; never normalise scale silently.
units_and_currency.conflict: If header scale and a printed subtotal are inconsistent by a factor of 1,000, trust neither: route the statement to review.

scope_selection.column_guard: Every fact carries the resolved (entity_scope, period, currency, unit). Two facts for the same canonical_key that differ on any of these are distinct facts, not duplicates.

normalisation.note: Applied to every candidate row label and every alias before comparison. Folding is what allows a single Chinese alias to cover both scripts.
pipeline: Traditional to Simplified fold (OpenCC t2s) applied to BOTH sides of the comparison, so 銷售成本 and 销售成本 collapse to one key.
Full-width to half-width punctuation; map ╱ ／ ⁄ to /; map （） to (); map 、 to , .
Strip footnote and note markers: trailing digits in parentheses, superscripts, '(note 12)', '附註12', '(附注12)'.
Strip trailing colons and dashes used to introduce sub-captions ('Share of profits and losses of:').
Strip inline unit and currency annotations: "RMB'000", '人民幣千元', '(unaudited)', '（未經審核）'.
Collapse internal whitespace to a single space; strip zero-width characters and soft hyphens.
Join a wrapped caption to its continuation line before matching, then also retain the bare fragment as a fallback candidate.
normalisation.wrapped_caption_rule: On a bilingual HKEX statement a caption printed across two physical lines ('TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE' / '年內全面虧損總額' / 'LOSS FOR THE YEAR') must be reassembled from the value row upward before matching. Match the reassembled string first; only if that fails may the bare fragment be used, and then only against concepts whose include criteria explicitly admit the fragment.

binding.note: Precedence is section-first. A concept can only claim a row printed inside one of its section_scope values.
order: 1. Resolve the statement (balance_sheet / profit_and_loss / cash_flow) from the page or table caption.

2. Resolve the printed section from the nearest preceding section header. If no header is resolvable, the row is unbound: route to review, never guess a section. (A row WITH a resolved section that no concept claims is not unbound — it is swept into that section's residual; see unbound_row_policy.)
3. Restrict the candidate concept set to concepts whose section_scope contains the resolved section.
4. Rule tier: exact normalised alias, then regex_hints, in descending match_priority. Any exclude_hints hit is a hard veto, not a score penalty.
5. Semantic tier over the restricted set only, using definition + include + exclude. Never over the full ontology.
6. Tie between concepts listed in each other's confusable_with: resolve with section_disambiguation; if still tied, emit both as candidates and route to review. Never pick by declaration order.
7. Residual sweep (see residual_framework) runs last, over rows no dedicated concept claimed.
8. Reconcile the section against its reported subtotal.
binding.unbound_row_policy: ADOPTED POLICY: a face VALUE row printed inside a resolved section that no dedicated concept claimed is swept into that section's residual ('Others'), itemised with its original label and sign. This is chosen over emitting an unbound_fact for review because the section subtotal then still ties, and a spread whose subtotal does not tie is harder to review than one carrying a named Others component. The row is never relabelled and never invisible: it appears as a component of the residual with its own label, value and provenance, and the residual's review triggers still fire. The sweep's eligibility rules are NOT relaxed by this. A section subtotal, statement total, section header, attribution caption, per-share figure, narrative sentence or note-reference-only row is still ineligible and is still emitted as an unbound_fact routed to review — putting a narrative sentence into Others would corrupt the subtotal by whatever the sentence happened to contain, which is a defect this project has already fixed once. A row whose SECTION could not be resolved at all is likewise still routed to review: without a section there is no residual to sweep it into, and guessing one is what cross-section rescue forbids.
binding.match_priority: Integer 0-99, higher evaluated first. Long specific captions rank above short generic ones so 'Total assets less current liabilities' cannot be pre-empted by 'Total current liabilities' on token overlap. Residuals are 0 and unreachable by matching.

netting_rules.condition: Apply ONLY where the filing shows cost of sales is presented INCLUSIVE of these operating expenses — a cost-of-sales note itemising staff costs, depreciation or selling and administrative expenses within it, or a by-nature presentation folded into cost of sales. Where the face presents them as separate lines outside cost of sales (the usual by-function HKFRS case), the rule does NOT apply and nothing is netted.
netting_rules.label: Cost of sales reported inclusive of operating expenses. Net out only on positive evidence.
netting_rules.on_apply: Set allocation_status: calculated_residual and record the subtracted keys and the note reference on the fact.

netting_rules.condition: Face prints only a single income tax expense line and the tax note reconciles it to current and deferred components.
netting_rules.on_apply: Populate the two children from the note and retain the face total as the validation target. Set allocation_status: child_component on each child. If the children do not sum to the face total within tolerance, populate neither and route to review.

residual_framework.note: One definition governing all 13 residual concepts. This replaces the v1 others_policy, which stated intent but gave the engine no mechanism.

sweep.runs: after all dedicated concepts in the section have been resolved, before section reconciliation
sweep.candidate_set: every printed value row on the FACE of the statement whose resolved section equals the residual's single section_scope value
eligibility: The row printed a value for the selected entity_scope, period, currency and unit.
No dedicated concept whose section_scope contains this section claimed the row.
The row is not a section subtotal, statement total, section header, attribution caption, per-share figure, narrative row or note-reference-only row.
The row was printed INSIDE this section. A row printed in any other section is ineligible however similar its wording — there is no cross-section rescue.

The row's sign agrees with the section's sign_convention, where the section states one. A row signed against its section is evidence the SECTION is wrong, not the amount, so it goes to review rather than into the bucket — a cost swept into income moves the income subtotal and every total below it.
sweep.plug_behaviour: forbidden — the residual is never computed as (reported subtotal − mapped children)
sweep.literal_others_caption: A row captioned 'Others' / '其他' is simply one unmapped face row and sweeps in as a single component. It gets no privileged treatment and no dedicated concept.

itemisation.rule: The residual's value is the arithmetic sum of its components. Original labels and signs are always retained; a swept row is never relabelled to 'Others'.

reconciliation.identity: reported_section_subtotal − Σ(dedicated concepts in section) − Σ(residual components) = 0
reconciliation.tolerance: one rounding unit per contributing row
reconciliation.on_failure: Emit an unallocated_gap fact carrying the difference and route the section to review. Never adjust the residual, and never adjust a dedicated concept, to close the gap.
reconciliation.sections_without_reported_subtotal: If the section prints no subtotal, the residual is still itemised but is flagged unreconciled and carries lower confidence.

review_triggers: any single component exceeds 2% of |reported section subtotal|
a component label scored at or above the semantic threshold against a dedicated concept but was vetoed by exclude_hints
residual sign is opposite to the section's sign_convention
the section reconciliation emitted an unallocated_gap
prohibitions: Never populated by alias, regex or embedding match.
Never carries a value with no itemised components.
Never absorbs a row a dedicated concept could have claimed but was not tested for — all dedicated concepts in the section must be evaluated first.
Never spans sections, statements, periods, entity scopes or units.

parent_child_allocation: Never load a gross parent and its separately mapped children additively.
Residual = reported parent minus confirmed included children.
Subtract only on explicit inclusion wording, hierarchy, reconciliation or arithmetic support.
If containment is uncertain, retain the parent as evidence and route to review.
global_rules.duplicate_fact_rule: The same economic fact on the face and in a note is one fact with multiple evidence references, not two additive values. This also applies to two face captions that report the same amount (see equivalence blocks).
global_rules.totals_policy: Compute totals from mutually exclusive concept outputs. Use reported totals only for validation, never as an input to the components.
global_rules.no_fabricated_split: Never invent a decomposition. Where only a combined figure is reported, load the combined concept and leave the children empty. The one exception is a concept declaring sole_component_of: assigning a whole undifferentiated figure to a single child divides nothing, and it is refused as soon as any sibling child is evidenced on the face or in the subtotal's own note.
global_rules.face_only_default: Concepts default to face_only: true. Notes are evidence for a face amount, never an independent source of one, unless note_use is decomposition_allowed.

sign_convention.stored_value: The reported value after paren-to-negative conversion.
sign_convention.expenses_and_outflows: Stored NEGATIVE. This is required by the template: pl_gross_profit = sum(revenue, cost_of_goods_sold) and pl_profit_before_exceptional_items_and_tax = sum(total_income, total_operating_cost, total_non_operating_expense) only hold if expense concepts carry a negative sign.
sign_convention.unsigned_source: Where a filing prints expenses as unsigned positives in a by-nature list, negate on load and set sign_normalised: true on the fact so the transformation is auditable.
sign_convention.either: Subtotals, working-capital movements, fair-value changes, share of results, OCI and net cash flows are sign-indeterminate. Retain the reported sign; never coerce.
sign_convention.validation: A concept whose sign_convention is positive_expected or negative_expected but whose loaded value carries the opposite sign is a review trigger, not an auto-correction.

mutually_exclusive_groups.rule: Populate the aggregate only when the face prints a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' line. If any component is printed, populate components and leave the aggregate null.
mutually_exclusive_groups.note: The template's bs_equity__reserves rollup lists all of these. Loading the aggregate and its components together double-counts, and that rollup is what reports the disagreement when a filing prints both.

mutually_exclusive_groups.rule: Combined face line populates the aggregate. Separately printed lines populate the components. Never both.
An indirect-method cash flow starts from profit before tax OR from profit for the year. Populate whichever the face prints and leave the other null.
mutually_exclusive_groups.note: The template's operating rollup lists both starting lines because exactly one is ever printed, which is how the spec's COALESCE is expressed without a COALESCE operator. A filing populating both would count its profit twice in operating profit before working capital changes.

mutually_exclusive_groups.rule: Populate the subtotal only when the face prints a single undifferentiated other comprehensive income line. If either category is printed, populate the categories and leave the subtotal null.
mutually_exclusive_groups.note: The template's pl_other_comprehensive_income_for_the_year rollup lists both categories. Loading the printed subtotal alongside them double-counts other comprehensive income, and the rollup reports the disagreement when a filing prints both.

identities.note: One economic fact under two captions; see the equivalence blocks.
Holds only under the negative-expense sign convention.
The primary guard against the wrapped-caption confusion between the two bottom lines.

The three terms are the CLOSING subtotal of each activity section, spelled as the template declares them. Earlier revisions wrote them as the shorthand net_operating/net_investing/net_financing, which the template has never declared, so this blocking identity resolved to nothing and stayed skipped on every filing.
A break here is usually restricted cash or pledged deposits wrongly swept into cash and cash equivalents, or an overdraft presented within cash.

An independent route to net assets: the ladder reaches it through net current assets, this reaches it through total assets, so a figure double-counted between the two sections breaks one and not the other. The equity attribution and the reserves composition are NOT here — the revised rollups on bs_equity__total_equity and bs_equity__reserves already assert exactly those two sums.

The other half of the spec's COALESCE_MATCHED: this pairs with cf_pbt_agreement, and because a cash flow starts from one line or the other, exactly one of the two ever has both operands and runs. Comparing the cash flow's starting profit against the WRONG P&L line would fail by the tax charge on every correct filing.

Restates the new rollup so the composition carries the spec's severity: a filing whose two IAS 1 categories disagree with the printed subtotal has a classification difference worth a look, not a broken statement. Skips when either side is absent.

The tax charge added back in the cash flow is the tax charge in profit or loss, with the sign reversed because expenses are stored negative. Skips on a cash flow that starts after tax, where there is no add-back to compare.

Depreciation and amortisation added back in the cash flow against the charge in profit or loss. The spec asks for a 0.5% tolerance, which an identity cannot carry, so this runs on the shared tolerance: a small break here is usually depreciation capitalised into inventory or a development asset rather than an extraction error.

Finance costs added back in the cash flow against interest expense in profit or loss. The spec marks this advisory with a 2% tolerance; the severity enum has no advisory level and an identity carries no tolerance, so it is a warning — capitalised interest causes a legitimate variance and a break here is a question, not a defect.

cross_concept_guards.rule: A concept whose sign_convention is positive_expected or negative_expected carrying the opposite sign.
bs_non_current_assets__investments_in_subsidiaries populated on a column resolved as consolidated.
bs_equity__reserves populated together with any of its listed components.
pl_exceptional_items__share_of_profit_of_associates_and_jvs populated together with either separate share line.
pl_profit_for_the_year equal to pl_total_comprehensive_income_for_the_year while pl_other_comprehensive_income_for_the_year is non-zero.
bs_equity__non_controlling_interests equal to pl_profit_attributable_to__non_controlling_interests — almost always the balance-versus-flow confusion.

validation.section_reconciliation: Every section with a reported subtotal must satisfy the residual_framework reconciliation identity. Failure emits unallocated_gap and blocks auto-approval of that section.

worked_examples.scenario: Current assets section prints: Inventories 400; Trade receivables 900; Deposits and prepayments 120; Amounts due from a director 30; Others 15; Cash and cash equivalents 500; TOTAL CURRENT ASSETS 1,965.
worked_examples.instruction: The residual value was computed as the sum of its two components, never as 1,965 minus the mapped lines.
worked_examples.resolution: Dedicated concepts claim inventories, trade receivables, deposits/prepayments (prepayments_other_receivables_and_other_assets) and cash. 'Amounts due from a director' and 'Others' are unmapped face rows in this section, so both sweep.
worked_examples.reconciliation: 1,965 − (400+900+120+500) − 45 = 0. Residual is 2.3% of the subtotal; below the 5% trigger, and no single component exceeds 2%, so no review is raised.

worked_examples.scenario: Same section, but OCR drops the 'Amounts due from a director' row entirely. Mapped lines total 1,920 and the printed subtotal is 1,965.
worked_examples.instruction: The residual stays at 15. The 30 becomes an explicit unallocated_gap. Inflating the residual to 45 to force the subtotal to tie is the exact failure mode this framework exists to prevent.

worked_examples.scenario: 'Deferred tax assets 80' is printed inside the CURRENT assets section by a filing that classifies it there.

output.review_reason: component label matched a dedicated concept in a different section

worked_examples.instruction: Bind to the printed section and surface the classification difference for review. Never reach across sections to a better-fitting concept.
worked_examples.resolution: bs_non_current_assets__deferred_income_tax_assets has section_scope [bs_s1_non_current_assets] and cannot claim a row printed in the current section. No dedicated current-asset concept covers it.

worked_examples.scenario: Other income 50, of which Interest income 12 disclosed within it.
Other income 38 and Interest income 12 printed as separate face lines.
Statement prints 'LOSS FOR THE YEAR 年內虧損 (1,200)' and further down 'TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE / 年內全面虧損總額 / LOSS FOR THE YEAR (1,350)'.
worked_examples.instruction: Reassemble the wrapped caption before matching. The bare fragment 'LOSS FOR THE YEAR' on the lower row belongs to the total-comprehensive concept; identity pl_tci_tie confirms the assignment.

worked_examples.scenario: Balance sheet equity shows 'Non-controlling interests 2,400'. Profit or loss shows 'Non-controlling interests 180' under 'Profit attributable to:'. Total comprehensive section shows 'Non-controlling interests 165'.
worked_examples.instruction: Three concepts, identical caption. Section_scope plus unit_of_account resolves all three without any wording disambiguation.

worked_examples.scenario: Filing prints '銷售成本'. Ontology alias is '销售成本'.
worked_examples.instruction: Both sides fold to 销售成本 in the normalisation pipeline and match exactly. No Traditional variant needs to be enumerated in the alias list.
